title: Property Matching Accuracy
topic: Matching property listings to explicit buyer constraints

questions.question: In a hypothetical scenario, a buyer requires a 3-bedroom house under Rp 2,000,000,000 with a garden. Which listing matches all criteria?
options: Listing D: 4 bedrooms, Rp 1,700,000,000, no garden
Listing B: 3 bedrooms, Rp 1,950,000,000, garden included
Listing A: 2 bedrooms, Rp 1,800,000,000, garden included
Listing C: 3 bedrooms, Rp 2,100,000,000, garden included
questions.explanation: Listing B meets the bedroom count, price limit, and garden requirement.
